name: on-track-fitness
description: ON TRACK - Precision Session Builder, Workout Timer & Movement Library

scripts.prepare-assets: mkdir -p www && cp -R index.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js css js icons fonts www/
scripts.cap:add: npm run prepare-assets && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build-apk: npm run prepare-assets && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
